# 制作/修改保存后：把 GUI 五槽写入宝物变量，下次编辑可精确还原层数
skonester_acm_persist_craft_slots_on_artifact_effect = {
  if = {
    limit = { exists = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator }
    if = {
      limit = { exists = scope:skonester_new_crafted_artifact }
      scope:skonester_new_crafted_artifact = {
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m1 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m1 }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt1 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m1_cnt }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m2 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m2 }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt2 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m2_cnt }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m3 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m3 }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt3 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m3_cnt }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m4 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m4 }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt4 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m4_cnt }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m5 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m5 }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt5 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m5_cnt }
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = { exists = global_var:skonester_acm_repair_target }
      global_var:skonester_acm_repair_target = {
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m1 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m1 }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt1 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m1_cnt }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m2 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m2 }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt2 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m2_cnt }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m3 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m3 }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt3 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m3_cnt }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m4 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m4 }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt4 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m4_cnt }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m5 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m5 }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt5 value = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator.var:skonester_craft_m5_cnt }

# 从宝物已保存的槽位变量恢复到玩家 GUI
skonester_acm_load_craft_slots_from_artifact_saved_effect = {
  global_var:skonester_acm_repair_target = {
    save_scope_as = skonester_acm_slot_src
    root = {
      if = {
        limit = { scope:skonester_acm_slot_src = { has_variable = skonester_acm_saved_m1 } }
        set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m1 value = scope:skonester_acm_slot_src.var:skonester_acm_saved_m1 }
      }
      else = { set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m1 value = 0 } }
      if = {
        limit = { scope:skonester_acm_slot_src = { has_variable = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt1 } }
        set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m1_cnt value = scope:skonester_acm_slot_src.var:skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt1 }
      }
      else = { set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m1_cnt value = 0 } }
      if = {
        limit = { scope:skonester_acm_slot_src = { has_variable = skonester_acm_saved_m2 } }
        set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m2 value = scope:skonester_acm_slot_src.var:skonester_acm_saved_m2 }
      }
      else = { set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m2 value = 0 } }
      if = {
        limit = { scope:skonester_acm_slot_src = { has_variable = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt2 } }
        set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m2_cnt value = scope:skonester_acm_slot_src.var:skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt2 }
      }
      else = { set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m2_cnt value = 0 } }
      if = {
        limit = { scope:skonester_acm_slot_src = { has_variable = skonester_acm_saved_m3 } }
        set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m3 value = scope:skonester_acm_slot_src.var:skonester_acm_saved_m3 }
      }
      else = { set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m3 value = 0 } }
      if = {
        limit = { scope:skonester_acm_slot_src = { has_variable = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt3 } }
        set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m3_cnt value = scope:skonester_acm_slot_src.var:skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt3 }
      }
      else = { set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m3_cnt value = 0 } }
      if = {
        limit = { scope:skonester_acm_slot_src = { has_variable = skonester_acm_saved_m4 } }
        set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m4 value = scope:skonester_acm_slot_src.var:skonester_acm_saved_m4 }
      }
      else = { set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m4 value = 0 } }
      if = {
        limit = { scope:skonester_acm_slot_src = { has_variable = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt4 } }
        set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m4_cnt value = scope:skonester_acm_slot_src.var:skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt4 }
      }
      else = { set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m4_cnt value = 0 } }
      if = {
        limit = { scope:skonester_acm_slot_src = { has_variable = skonester_acm_saved_m5 } }
        set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m5 value = scope:skonester_acm_slot_src.var:skonester_acm_saved_m5 }
      }
      else = { set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m5 value = 0 } }
      if = {
        limit = { scope:skonester_acm_slot_src = { has_variable = skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt5 } }
        set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m5_cnt value = scope:skonester_acm_slot_src.var:skonester_acm_saved_m_cnt5 }
      }
      else = { set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m5_cnt value = 0 } }
    }
  }
}

skonester_acm_clear_craft_slot_vars_effect = {
  set_variable = { name = skonester_acm_sync_next_slot value = 1 }
  remove_variable = skonester_acm_tmp_stack
  remove_variable = skonester_acm_tmp_neg
  set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m1 value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m2 value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m3 value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m4 value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m5 value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m1_cnt value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m2_cnt value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m3_cnt value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m4_cnt value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m5_cnt value = 0 }
}

# 选中宝物后：GUI 制作宝物读入五槽；原版/外来宝物保持空槽（保存时追加修饰）
skonester_acm_load_modifier_slots_from_artifact_effect = {
  if = {
    limit = { exists = global_var:skonester_acm_repair_target }
    root = { skonester_acm_clear_craft_slot_vars_effect = yes }
    if = {
      limit = {
        global_var:skonester_acm_repair_target = { has_variable = skonester_acm_from_gui_craft }
      }
      if = {
        limit = {
          global_var:skonester_acm_repair_target = { has_variable = skonester_acm_saved_m1 }
        }
        skonester_acm_load_craft_slots_from_artifact_saved_effect = yes
      }
      else = {
        skonester_acm_detect_craft_slots_from_artifact_modifiers_effect = yes
      }
    }
    root = {
      skonester_acm_sync_craft_layer_quality_effect = yes
      skonester_acm_clamp_craft_slot_layers_to_quality_effect = yes
    }
  }
}
